description: Gemini Pro (1.0) was Google's first-generation general-purpose model in the Gemini family. It offered balanced performance for text generation tasks. This model has been superseded by the Gemini 1.5 series.

architecture.note: Vision capabilities available via separate Gemini Pro Vision variant

trainingData.description: Trained on a diverse corpus of text data. Specific training data composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Trained using advanced techniques including instruction tuning. Specific methodology is proprietary.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Competitive performance on text generation benchmarks at launch. Now superseded by Gemini 1.5 models with improved capabilities.

knownLimitations: Superseded by Gemini 1.5 Pro and Flash models
Smaller context window compared to 1.5 series (32K vs 1M+)
Text-only input (requires Vision variant for images)
May generate incorrect or misleading information

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Google applies safety training to reduce harmful outputs and biases.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Built-in safety filters and content moderation.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: API data handling governed by Google Cloud terms.

access.license: Proprietary - Google Cloud Terms of Service
